profile.headline: EE | Systems/Edge AI | Secret Clearance | Northrop Grumman, Toyota , Daimler | Published On-board AI research
profile.summary:
Electrical engineer working at the intersection of embedded hardware and AI from RF/PCB systems to on-device machine learning. Active Secret clearance.
Currently at Northrop Grumman across two internships: avionics test bench development, RF functional testing and schematic review, and building a LangChain-based RAG agent used by engineers, technicians, and program managers for documentation workflows.
Co-first author on an edge-AI paper (HumanSys ’26, ACM MobiCom Workshop) — a 91.8%-accurate on-device muscle stiffness classifier running at 37.9ms latency with 2.8–7.2x lower energy than BLE offload. Presenting related work at the 60th Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers.
Additional systems experience: CAN-bus/PCB prototyping at Daimler Truck, DFMEA and quality engineering at Toyota.
Graduating May 2027 — open to systems engineering, embedded/AI, and hardware-software integration roles in defense and tech.
